summary: The article accurately presents the RBI's directive on the timely return of property documents, including compensation for delays and procedures for lost documents. All key factual claims are verified by authoritative sources.

claims.claim: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) mandates lenders to return original property documents within 30 days of loan repayment.
claims.note: RBI notification dated September 13, 2023, states REs shall release documents within 30 days.

claims.claim: If the lender delays beyond 30 days due to their fault, they must pay compensation of ₹5,000 per day to the borrower.
claims.note: The RBI notification specifies compensation of ₹5,000 per day for delays attributable to the RE beyond 30 days.

claims.claim: This directive, effective from December 1, 2023, aims to protect borrowers and ensure responsible lending practices.
claims.note: The directions are applicable to all cases where the release of original documents falls due on or after December 1, 2023.

claims.claim: Through its notification dated September 13, 2023, the RBI issued directions on 'Responsible Lending Conduct – Release of Movable/Immovable Property Documents on Repayment/Settlement of Personal Loans'.
claims.note: The RBI indeed issued a notification with this title and date.

claims.claim: In case of lost or damaged documents, the lender must assist in obtaining duplicates and bear costs, with an extended 30-day period (total 60 days) before compensation applies.
claims.note: The RBI notification states that in case of lost/damaged documents, REs shall assist in obtaining duplicates and bear costs, with an additional 30 days (total 60 days) before compensation applies.

claims.claim: If the lender fails to resolve your complaint within 30 days of filing it, or if you are not satisfied with their resolution, you can then approach the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme (RB-IOS).
claims.note: The RB-IOS allows complaints if the RE does not respond within 30 days or if the complainant is not satisfied.

article_title: Delayed Property Papers? Get ₹5,000/Day from Lender
